def solve(inputs: dict) -> float:
    M = inputs['matrix']
    power = inputs['power']
    modulus = inputs['modulus']
    result = [[1, 0], [0, 1]]  # Identity matrix
    base = M
    while power > 0:
        if power % 2 == 1:
            result = [[(result[0][0] * base[0][0] + result[0][1] * base[1][0]) % modulus, (result[0][0] * base[0][1] + result[0][1] * base[1][1]) % modulus],
                     [(result[1][0] * base[0][0] + result[1][1] * base[1][0]) % modulus, (result[1][0] * base[0][1] + result[1][1] * base[1][1]) % modulus]]
        base = [[(base[0][0] * base[0][0] + base[0][1] * base[1][0]) % modulus, (base[0][0] * base[0][1] + base[0][1] * base[1][1]) % modulus],
                [(base[1][0] * base[0][0] + base[1][1] * base[1][0]) % modulus, (base[1][0] * base[0][1] + base[1][1] * base[1][1]) % modulus]]
        power //= 2
    return (result[0][0] + result[0][1] + result[1][0] + result[1][1]) % modulus
